text: いつ　きても　この　ポケモン　ジムは　しまっとる　いったい　どんな　ヤツが　リーダーを　しとるんじゃろか？

structure.jp: この　ポケモン　ジムは　しまっとる
いったい　どんな　ヤツが
structure.en: what on earth kind of person

structure.jp: リーダーを　しとるんじゃろか？
structure.en: is being the Leader, I wonder?

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: A question word plus a verb with ても means 'no matter', here 'no matter when'. いつ きても = 'whenever I come'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says a state is in place now. とる is an old-man short form of ておる, which is the same as ている. しまっとる = 'is closed'.

patterns.name: 〜だろうか
patterns.explanation: だろうか at the end means 'I wonder'. じゃろか is the old-man way of saying it. しとるんじゃろか = 'I wonder who is doing it'.
